pattern: SELECT .+ COUNT\(Has_[A-Za-z]+\.\w+\) FROM .+ JOIN .+ ON .+\.[\w]+ = .+\.\w+ GROUP BY .+\.\w+
correction: Replace the COUNT function with count(*), and ensure that the count(*) is included in the SELECT clause.

metadata.description: This rule corrects SQL queries where the COUNT function is incorrectly used to count a specific column instead of all records.
